tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bzhugs so//

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bshad par bya ste/ drag po'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas/ sa phyogs gnag cing dri nga ba gdug pa can gyi sar 'byung po nyi ma la/ dgra la byed na mtshan phyed/ bgegs la byed na nyin phyed kyi dus su/ dkyil 'khor gyi ni lho'i phyogs su drag po'i thab khung gru gsum pa sor nyi shu pa/ zabs su sor bcu/ sor gsum gyi tshad kyi kha khyer phyir gyes pa dang steng du phyogs pa'i gsum rim can/ nang du khro bo'i phyag mtshan/ phyi nang du dug khrag dang ro sol gyis nag por byas pa'am bris pa/ kha nub tu phyogs pa/ kha ran la seng ldeng ngam/ nim pa'am/ gdug pa can gyi shing*/ dug khrag gis byugs pa thab dang mthun par brtsig gdug pa'i shing de dag gi rtse mo'i cha las byung ba sor bcu gnyis pa'i yam shing dang*/ yungs kar nag gi mar khu dang*/ dug dang khrag gis sbags pa'i rabs chad nag po'i rus pa'i phye ma dang*/ yungs kar dang*/ yungs nag dang*/ ke tshe dang*/ shangs tshe dang*/ til nag po dang*/ dug gi me tog nag po dang*/ dug sna tshogs tshad dang*/ khrag sna tshogs pa thod par bshams/ dgug gzhug lha dbye legs par byas pa'i ling ga rnams la 'jig rten pa dang 'das pa'i sreg rdzas cha gnyis su byas pa dang*/ khrag gi ar+ghaṃ/ dug chu'i zhabs bsil/ rang byung gi chu zhal bsil dang dug gi me tog gsur chen gyi spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ pad+ma rak+ta'i yon chab/ sha sna snying sna'i zhal zas/ rkang gling sogs kyi rol mo/ dgang blug gzar/ brab pa'i thun rdzas/ gdab pa'i mtshon cha bzhag bgo ba'i gos nag dang zhwa nag lus dug khrag ro sol gyis byugs/ g.yang gzhi'i steng du rdo rje'i 'dug stangs kyis bstan pa la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad bsgral bar bya'o snyam du zhe gnag pa'i sems kyis skyabs su 'gro ba nas lha drug bsgom/ bzlas pa byas/ dur khrod dam shan pa'i khyim nas me blangs la sbar te/

oṃ ag+neḥdz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐ zhes pas me sbar/ badz+ra dh-i ka sarba sha trūn mā ra ya zhes pas mar khu sreg blugs lan gsum byin/ me'i pra la brtag ste/ dri med mdangs che me lce g.yas su 'khyil// 'ja' 'am dkar dmar snum bkrag 'gab nas 'phro// zhi ba'i 'od zer dang 'dra bkra shis dang*// phyag mtshon rnams dbyibs dri zhim me mdag med// mchog yin de las bzlog na ngan par bshad// ngan na/ oṃ a bigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭ ces pas slar mar khu sreg blugs lan bdun byin no// des bgegs rnams bzlog par 'gyur ro// de nas bsang gtor byas pa'i ku sha thogs te/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i 'dab ma'i snying*// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed cing*// tshangs pa lha yi dag byed yin// zhes thab kyi kha khyer la g.yas bskor du dgram mo// de nas thab bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bh+rūṃ las drag po'i thab khung nag po 'jigs su rung ba gru gsum pa/ kha ran can mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma/ ma las nyi ma/ raṃ las me lha nag po khros shing 'khrugs pa'i zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dmar ba'i spyan gsum/ 'jigs pa chen pos 'jigs par byed pa'i gzugs can/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis bgrang 'phreng dang mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya/ 'og ma gnyis dbyug gu dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ mchod phyir thogs dang thal ris gsum pas mtshan pas/ dar gyis smad dkris te ra skyes la zhon pa/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas me lha'i ye shes sems dpa' mdun gyi nam mkhar dzaḥ hūm̐ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas 'di bzhes la// 'bar ba'i nang du bzhugs su gsol// zhes skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya las mthe bong srin lag gi drung du bzhag la/ ag+na ye e h+ye hi ma hā bhū ta de wa ṛ ṣi dwi dza/ sarbot+ta ma/

gṛ ha sdo hu ti/ ma hā rasmin san+ni he to bha wa/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ ag+neḥde wa ta ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ/ āñja mā nāṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shap+ta/ ag+na ye/ ha bya ka bya ba hā na ya a di bya/ ma hā na ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa byon skyems su phul/ de nas/ hūm̐/ me yi lha ni gzi brjid che// 'dod don thams cad ster ba po// bdag dang gzhan don mdzad pa yi// drang srong che la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jig rten mgon po tshangs pa'i sras// me lha'i rgyal po dag byed mchog /bgegs rnams ma lus sreg mdzad pa// 'jigs byed che la phyag 'tshal bstod// ye shes 'od kyis nyon mongs sreg /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu dang ldan// nyes pa'i skyon rnams sangs par mdzad// thugs rje che la phyag 'tshal bstod// bden pa'i tshig gis mi bslu ba// 'jig rten skyong rnams kun gyi gtso// tshangs par gyur pa'i dag ldan pa// rnam 'dren khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod nas/ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥbadz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ā be sha a/ lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu'i phyag rgyas dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ de nas chu gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lngas mchod/ sngar bzhin bstod la/ oṃ ag+neḥde wa ta ye hūm̐ phaṭ kyis/ yam shing*/ sngags de nyid kyis mar khu/ rus phye/ yungs kar/ ke tshe/ shangs tshe/ til/ dug khrag ling ga sreg blugs su bdun bdun 'bul bar bya'o// slar yang mchod bstod byas te me lha de nyid 'bar ba'i mer gyur pa'i nang du bh+rūṃ las nas/ lha bskyed gnas gsum skye mched byin gyis brlab/ ye shes spyan 'dren/ dgug gzhug bcas dbang bskur ba'i bar mdun bskyed bzhin la/ hūm̐/ dmar chen khrag sna rgya mtsho'i ar+ghaṃ sbreng*// mi bzad dug rlangs khol ba'i zhabs bkru sbyar// rang byung rdo rje chu yi zhabs bsil phab// dug gi me tog ci mchis 'phreng bar spel// gsur chen bsregs pa'i ngad pas phyogs bcu bkang*// zhun gyi snang byed nyi ma'i 'od du rdzu// pad rag byug pa mtshams kyi sprin ltar chags// snying dang sha sna ri ltar gnyer ba dang*// rnga gling 'brug ltar bsgrag pas mchod par bgyi// gzhan yang drag po'i las la rngam rnams thugs// dgyes pa cis bskyed de yi mchod pa'i sprin// mtha' yas nam mkha'i khong par mi chud pa// blo yis sprul te khro rgyal tshogs la 'bul// oṃ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

pā d+yaṃ/ āñca mā nāṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ ne wi d+ye/ shap+da zhes pas mchod/ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i raṃ dang zhes sogs kyis bstod/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar raṃ las thams cad kyang rnam pa sreg byed kyi lhar bsams la/ de nas yam shing khro bo'i sngags 'dis 'bul lo// oṃ ha ra ha ra badz+ra/ ma tha ma tha badz+ra/ dhu na dhu na badz+ra/ da ha da ha badz+ra/ pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra/ dha ra dha ra badz+ra/ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya badz+ra/ dā ru ṇa dā ru ṇa badz+ra/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da badz+ra/ bhin+da bhin+da badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭ/ sarba sha trūn a mu kaṃ mā ra ya phaṭ/ rnal 'byor pa bdag la snga dgra lag la brdar zhing phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra dngos su byed pa'i dgra bo 'di 'khor dang bcas pa mā ra ya phaṭ/ ces pa'i 'dod gsol kun la sbyar ro// brgya rtsa brgyad phul/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ sarba sha trūn hūm̐ a mu kaṃ mā ra ya phaṭ kyis mar khu lan brgya rtsa brgyad/ 'brub khung bskyed pa nas rdul du 'thag pa'i bar gyis gdab las byas nas ling ro/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma sh+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tru ṭa tru ṭa/ tro ṭa ya tro ṭa ya/ s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya/ ghur+ṇa ghur+ṇa/ ghūr+ṇā pa ya ghūr+ṇā pa ya/ sarba sa twā ni/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ saṃ bo dha ya saṃ bo dha ya/ bh+ra ma bh+ra ma/ saṃ bh+rā ma ya saṃ bh+rā ma ya/ sarba bhū tā ni/ kuṭ+ṭa kuṭ+ṭa/ saṃ kuṭ+ṭa ya saṃ kuṭ+ṭa ya/ sarba sha trūn/ gha ṭa gha ṭa/ saṃ gha ṭa ya saṃ gha ṭa ya/ sarba sha trūn/ a mu kaṃ mā ra ya phaṭ/ ces pa'i sngags kyis phul/ til/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭ/ sarba sha trūn hūm̐ a mu kaṃ mā ra ya phaṭ/ rus pa'i phye ma yang sngags des 'bul lo// yungs dkar zhi ba'i sngags/

he phu lu ni ru phul+lu/ gṛ h+na kul+lu/ mi li tsul+lu/ ku ru kul+lu/ badz+ra bi dza yā ya swā hā/ sarba sha trūn/ a mu kaṃ mā ra ya phaṭ/ yungs nag dbang gi ki li ki la ya swā hā/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ra ṭa ra ṭa/ mo ṭa na pra mo ṭa nā ya swā hā/ sarba sha trūn hūm̐ a mu kaṃ mā ra ya phaṭ/ ke tshe/ rgyas pa'i/ tsa ra ni tsa ra/ ha ra ha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ sarba sha trūn hūm̐/ a mu kaṃ mā ra ya phaṭ/ shangs tshe drag po'i/ mā ra ya badz+ra bi dā ra ṇā ya swā hā/ sarba sha trūn ma ra ya phaṭ/ dug sna/ rig sngags bcing pa'i/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ bhin+da bhin+da/ ma hā ki li ki lā ya swā hā/ sarba sha trūn hūm̐ a mu kaṃ mā ra ya phaṭ/ khrag rig sngags bcad pa'i/ ban+dha ban+dha/ kro dha badz+ra ki li ki lā ya swā hā/ sarba sha trūn hūm̐/ a mu kaṃ mā ra ya phaṭ/ dug gi me tog mthing nag gang la bsnyen pa bya ba'i sngags kyi mthar/ sarba sha trūn a mu kaṃ mā ra ya phaṭ/ btags la 'bul lo// de nas mchod cing bstod de/ 'dod don sngar bzhin gsol nas ye shes pa/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces gshegs/ dam tshig pa mer gyur pa slar 'jig rten pa'i me lha langs par gyur pa la/ sngar bzhin mchod cing sreg blugs phul/ bstod de badz+ra muḥ gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa mer gyur nas/ de dug gi chus bsad thal ba mnan par bya'o// zhi rgyas dbang gsum la dkyil 'khor mchod rdzas/ zhi ba la me tog ma sogs/ rgyas pa la bkra shis kyi lha mo brgyad/ dbang la rgyal srid sna bdun nam/ spros pa la dga' na thams cad bya'o// sreg rdzas thog mar thun mong ba 'bul te/ mar khu la snying po'i mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ yam shing la/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ya swā hā/ til la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na swā hā/ 'bras so ba la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ gro/ oṃghasam ri swā hā/ nas/ oṃ ma hā be ga swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ ma hā ba la swā hā/ dūrba/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/

thun mong ma yin pa'i sreg rdzas la/ zhi ba la zhi ba'i sngags kyi/ rgyas pa la rgyas pa'i/ dbang la dbang gi sngags kyi sham bu btags nas 'bul ba yin no// zhes shes par byas nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byed na/ sa dge zhing dkar ba dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar du/ thab khung zlum po khru gang ba/ zabs su khru phyed/ sor bzhi phyir son zhing*/ sor bzhi steng du brtsegs pa'i kha ran can dkar po/ mdog dkar zhing dri zhim pa 'o ma can gyi shing shis pa zlum por brtsig thun mong ba'i sreg rdzas dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i yam shing bud shing du bshad pa rtse mo'i cha las byung ba'i sor bcu gnyis/ til dang mar/ durba/ me tog dkar po 'o mas sbags pa/ mchod rdzas kyang las mthun bshams te chas gos dkar po gyon/ zhi ba'i sems kyis stan dkar po la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis 'dug ste/ bram ze'am dge slong dka' thub pa'i khyim nas me blangs sbar/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi snying pos sreg blugs byin/ me pra brtag bgegs bzlog pa/ ku sha dgram pa/ thab khung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bh+rūṃ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po yid du 'ong ba zlum po kha ran can mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma/ ma las nyi ma/ raṃ las me lha dkar po shin tu zhi ba'i nyams can zhal gcig spyan gsum dka' thub pa'i gzugs can/ zhes bskyed/ spyan drangs mchod/ byon skyems bstod pa dgug gzhug de nas mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar phul/ bstod/ de nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sreg rdzas 'bul/ sngags kyi khyad par/ oṃ ag+neḥde wa ta ye swā hā/ hūm̐ phaṭ kyi tshab thams cad du swā hā'o// bdag cag dpon slob thams cad kyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ mchod bstod/ sreg rdzas 'bul ba/ slar mchod bstod/ 'dod pa gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa mer bsgyur/

slar 'jig rten pa'i me lhar bskyed/ mchod bsregs blugs lhag ma 'bul/ bstod de gshegs su gsol lo// 'o ma can gyi chus bsad rjes mi mngon par bya'o// rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod na/ phun sum tshogs shing ser ba'i sar dkyil 'khor gyi byang phyogs su/ thab khung gru bzhi pa khru do zabs su khru phyed/ sor brgyad pa'i kha khyer rim pa gsum dang ser pos byug pa/ kha ran la 'o ma can nam 'bras bu can gyi shing dge ba'i bud shing gru bzhir brtsig thun mong ma yin pa'i sreg rdzas/ sngar bshad shing gi yam shing dang*/ mar 'bru ser dang me tog ser po dngar gsum gyis sbags pa/ mchod rdzas las mthun/ 'byor pa tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par 'dod pa'i sems kyis chas gos ser po dang ldan pa'i gdan ser po la rdo rje skyil krung gis/ rgyal po'am phyug po'i khyim nas me blangs spar/ brtag bzlog ku sha dgram/ thab khung bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las/ bhūṃ las rgyas pa'i thab khung ser po yid du 'ong ba gru bzhi kha ran can mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba'i nang du/ paṃ las pad+ma/ ma las nyi ma/ raṃ las me lha ser po shin tu dga' ba'i nyams can/ zhal gcig pa nas bskyed/ spyan drangs/ mchod/ byon skyems/ bstod/ dgug gzhug mchod bstod sreg blugs 'bul/ sngags mtha' zhi ba dang 'dra bar swā hā/ spel tshig bdag cag gi tshe dang bsod nams khyad par longs spyod rgya chen po puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ slar mchod bstod de mer bsgyur/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed nas dbang bskur/ mchod bstod de sreg rdzas 'bul ba/ mchod bstod gshegs bsgyur/ slar 'jig rten pa la mchod pa dang sregs blugs lhag ma phul bstod de gshegs/ dri bzang gi chus bsad rjes mi mngon par bya'o// dbang gi sbyin sreg byed par 'dod na/ sa snum la dmar zhing dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs su/ thab khung gzhu lta bu'am zla gam/

rgyar khru gang*/ zabs su khru phyed/ kha khyer sor bzhi la rim pa gsum bskor ba dmar po/ kha ran la 'bras bu can gyi shing dmar po me tog dmar po can gyis thab dang mthun par brtsig thun mong ma yin pa'i sreg rdzas/ sngar bshad shing gi yam shing rgya skyegs kyis byugs/ mar 'byung ba rtsi'i khrag gis dmar ba/ 'bru dmar po dang me tog dmar po dngar gyis sbags/ lan tshwa/ thams cad du dbang du bya bar 'dod pa'i sems kyis chas gos dmar po gdan dmar po la rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis 'dug nas/ smad 'tshong ngam tshong 'dus kyi me blangs sbar/ brtag bzlog dgram/ thab khung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/

bh+rūṃ las dbang gi thab khung dmar po yid du 'ong ba zla gam kha ran can mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba'i nang du/ paṃ las pad+ma/ ma las nyi ma/ raṃ las me lha dmar po chags pa'i nyams can zhal gcig nas/ bskyed/ spyan drangs/ mchod skyems bstod/ dgug mchod bstod/ sreg blugs 'bul/ sngags mtha' hrīḥste/ oṃ a g+neḥ de wa tā ya hrīḥ 'dod gsol/ bdag gis snang ba mi/ mi snang ba 'byung po mi ma yin thams cad dang 'byor pa thams cad ba shaṃ ma na ya hoḥ khyad par dgug par 'dod pa'i ming spel tshig tu bya'o// mchod bstod bsgyur/ 'das pa bskyed pa nas/ dbang bskur ba'i bar/ mchod bstod sreg rdzas 'bul/ mchod bstod gshegs bsgyur/ slar 'jig rten pa la sreg blugs bstod gshegs/ rgya skyegs kyi khu bas bsad rjes mi mngon par bya'o// zhi ba'i thab khung du gzhan du longs ma spyad pa'i me tog sngon po dkar gsum dang dngar gsum gyis rnam par sbags pa gang la bsnyen pa bya ba'i sngags kyis sreg blugs kyi mthar phul nas/ rig sngags kyi mthu thogs pa med pa'i 'dod don gsol zhing*/ gzhan 'dra ba la/ rim pa 'dis bsnyen pa ji tsam bya ba'i grangs kyi bcu cha'i sbyin sreg yongs su rdzogs par byas na rig sngags kyi las gang bsgrubs kyang thogs pa med par 'gyur ro// gzhan yang de yi sbyor ba la// me dbus bdag gi lha dmigs te// sngags bcas mar la bsnyugs pa yi// dūrba bsregs pa khri phrag gis// gang la bsnyen pa'i sngags kyi las// thogs pa med par byed pa'o// gal te las ma grub na spogs pa'i cho gas grub par byed pa ni/ rang gi mdun du maṇ+ḍal byas te/ der 'dod pa'i lha'i sku gzugs bzhugs la rang lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas lhag pa'i lha mdun du gsal bar dmigs nas/ de las sngags brjod pa dang bcas pa'i me tog khri phrag gcig phul la/ de nas me tog de rnams bsdus te/ de nyid kyis sreg rdzas byas pa'i sbyin sreg de snyed du byas na las ma grub pa rnams grub par byed par 'gyur ro// grub pa chud mi za bar bya ba'i phyir las kyi 'bras bu 'byung ba ni/

las dang mthun pa'i thab khung du bud shing brtsigs nas me sbar ba'i dbus su lhag pa'i lha gsal bar dmigs la/ de nas las gang bsgrub kyi spel tshig dang bcas pa'i sngags kyis de dang mthun pa'i sbyin sreg byas na/ bsgrubs ba'i las rnams chud mi za bar gang mngon par 'dod pa'i 'bras bu des 'byin par byed do// gzhan gyi mi dge ba'i las 'jig par 'dod na/ de'i rim pa 'di yin te/ dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i phyogs su zhi ba'i las dang mthun pa'i thab khung du bud shing brtsigs te/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas der me sbar ba'i dbus su lhag pa'i lha la kun nas dkar ba'i kha dog can du dmigs la/ de'i lus las dkar zhing bsil ba'i 'od zer byung bas pha rol po'i sdig pa thams cad 'jig par dmigs nas sngags dang bcas pa'i til gyis sbyin sreg byas pa'i mthar/ mchod bstod yi ge brgya pa brjod la gshegs su gsol/ de ltar pha rol po la dmigs nas yang dang yang du byas na de'i las ngan pa thams cad nges par 'jig par byed do// rgyas pa'i thab tu gzhan 'dra ba la/ sngags mthar ā yu dha rā ya/ dūrba me tog ser bsreg pas// tshe zad pa dang tshe nyams skyob// dbang gi thab tu sngags kyi mthar// wa shaṃ ya na ya btags la// me tog dmar po bsregs pa yis// mdza' sdug ma lus dbang du byed// drag po'i thab tu/ gzhan 'dra ba la/ gzhan gyi rig sngags shing shun nam gro ga la bris te dgug gzhug byas/ dug chur drangs nas ral gris gtubs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lā na yā che ge mo'i rig sngags ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brjod cing me'i nang du bsreg lan brgya rtsa brgyad du sbyin sreg gi las byas na gzhan gyi rig sngags bcad par 'gyur ro// rang gi mi dge ba'i las thams cad 'joms par 'dod na rin po che'i snod du tsan dan gyi sol ba la me bus te/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa'i mdun du til gyi snod bzhag la snying ga nas spros pa'i 'od kyis lhag pa'i lha mdun du spyan drangs nas/

de las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis bdag gi lus khyab pa dang*/ mi dge ba'i las kyis bsags pa'i dri ma rnams snying gar 'dus nas mi sdug pa'i gzugs can du gyur pa sna'i bu ga nas 'thon te/ til gyis bris pa'i gzugs la thim par bsams la ral gris dum bur gtubs pa sngags brjod pa dang bcas pas bsregs pa'i mthar mdun gyi lha'i lus las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs pas bdag nyid kyi lus kun tu gang bar bsgoms la/ yi ge brgya pa ci nus brjod nas gshegs pa'o// 'dis ni mi dge ba'i las thams cad bcom ste 'bras bu mi 'byin par byed do// sbyin sreg gi cho ga rdzogs so// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rgya gzhung rnams las rnyed pa bzhin/ yul dbus gra dar lung gi ri khrod du pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /maṅgalaṃ/// /
